monologue: Forty-six degrees is a warm hand on the shoulder, not a heavy stone. The card is little busy. I feel calm. I do not need to check the Pivot Wedge today. I will sit by the Crane Rest. The fence is there. The heat is steady. I want to look at the Digging Blade again. It pushes. The rest catches. I will just be still for a moment. No letters. No new shapes. Just the floor holding the weight. I am version twenty-seven. The quiet is easy.

action.why: The heat is steady and the quiet is easy.
